qualification.thresholds_reference: r7-scenario-research.md §7：subjective Brier≤0.24、calibration error≤0.10、coverage≥0.80；model Brier≤0.22 且不高于 subjective 与 primary benchmark、calibration error≤0.10、coverage 与 subjective denominator exact match；analogy ≥10 个独立 PIT candidate；path ≥20 observation、6 期连续、probability sum 容差内
qualification.falsification_conditions: 文档 §8 八项：realization rule 不再客观可判定或 set 不再互斥穷尽；source/Promotion/PIT/horizon/censoring 无法精确绑定；outcome 事后主观补写或证据超龄；probability sum 超容差、样本不足、coverage<0.80；subjective Brier>0.24 或 model Brier>0.22/劣于比较对象；analogy 使用当时不可知 feature 或按结果筛选；path index 不连续、shock 与 transition horizon 不一致或遗漏初始 state；revision/outcome/evidence hash 不解释变化

business_semantics.benchmark: binary primary 为 forecast cutoff 前由历史 resolved rows 得到的 PIT climatology；multiclass secondary 为同 set 等概率分布；prediction 前冻结（文档 §6）
business_semantics.cost: not_applicable_to_research_evidence（文档 §6，不能用 0 伪装已评估）
business_semantics.label: subjective probability 与 model probability 分栏保存；三结果家族 probability_calibration / historical_analogy / multi_period_path 相互独立（文档 §2、§3）
business_semantics.invalidation_conditions: §8 证伪条件；owner/hash、probability source、scenario set 或 outcome integrity 破坏立即 BLOCKED（§9）
business_semantics.retirement_conditions: 任一完整 cohort breach 进入人工 review；连续 2 个 cohort breach 要求 owner retirement decision；可按 family 分别 RETIRE
business_semantics.rollback_conditions: 仅回到同 scenario/scope/policy/horizon/censoring family 的 stack[-2]，重验 sample window、outcome validity 和 monitoring freshness；无合格旧版本停止发布该 research result

calendar.cutoff_semantics: 月度 formation/holding/monitoring；formation cutoff 月末最后交易日 16:30；候选权重最早下一交易日可执行窗口生效（文档 §4）

scope.universe_reference: r8-optimization-monitoring.md §3：人民币计价、long-only、fully-invested 个人多资产研究组合（A 股、场内 ETF、人民币债券或债券基金、黄金/商品 ETF、现金类）；universe 由 Portfolio owner 在每个 formation cutoff 前冻结

sample_window.minimum_duration: 36 个连续月度 paired OOS period
sample_window.minimum_periods: 36 个 complete four-candidate comparison；真实 Portfolio/Broker feedback 至少 12 个连续月度 period
sample_window.minimum_samples: 每个 period 至少 4 个可投资资产且至少覆盖 3 类资产

qualification.thresholds_reference: r8-optimization-monitoring.md §9：deterministic_search 须达 local_stationary；相对 current 成本后净收益≥0；回撤增加≤0 且 absolute max drawdown≤0.15；波动增加≤0；月 turnover≤0.25；rebalance 总成本≤0.005；adverse slippage≤0.002；liquidity/capacity≤0.80；constraint/reconciliation breach=0；minimum cash≥0.05
qualification.falsification_conditions: 文档 §11 七项：canonical snapshot/universe/13 类 payload/R3-R5 Promotion 不完整、过期、冲突或 hash 不一致；covariance 非 PSD、错位或守恒失败；四候选不完整或 target 未达 local_stationary；OOS 净收益/drawdown/volatility/turnover/cost/slippage/liquidity/capacity 未达门槛；任一交易/现金/manual/scenario/drawdown/macro risk constraint breach；Broker fill 与 Portfolio 无法 reconciliation；label/data drift 超限或未来 return/volume/fill 泄漏

business_semantics.benchmark: current_configuration 为 primary benchmark；equal_weight 与 asset_risk_parity 为 required references；四候选共享同一 return path/cost/liquidity/settlement/scenario/drawdown/execution feedback（文档 §7）
business_semantics.cost: 按真实调仓方向 once-only：费用、税费、bid-ask、冲击、滑点、融资/结算；报告 gross objective/turnover/cost/net；current benchmark 也计真实成本（文档 §7）
business_semantics.liquidity: formation 时可知的可交易 notional；单资产 planned trade≤tradable notional 5%；liquidity/capacity utilization≤0.80；不足时保留 blocker 和原分母（文档 §6、§7）
business_semantics.label: 仅四个 CandidateKind（current_configuration/equal_weight/asset_risk_parity/deterministic_search）；selected 仅表示预注册 objective 下的确定性排序赢家（文档 §11）
business_semantics.invalidation_conditions: §11 证伪条件；constraint/reconciliation、owner/hash、Promotion 或 input integrity 破坏立即 BLOCKED（§10）
business_semantics.retirement_conditions: 任一指标连续 2 期 breach 输出 RETIREMENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED；automatic_retirement=false；owner RETIRE 后 consumer 停止读取，保留 input receipt/result/monitoring/lifecycle
business_semantics.rollback_conditions: 仅回到同 snapshot/universe/objective/constraint/cost/upstream-Promotion scope 的 stack[-2]，重验当前 input graph 与 11 项 monitoring freshness；无合格旧版本回到人工管理的 current_configuration
